## Codec

- `encode_times(times_seconds, *, quantization_us=100) -> (deltas, meta)` — quantize + delta-encode a sorted event-time array.
- `decode_times(deltas, meta) -> times_seconds` — invert `encode_times`.
- `compress_array(arr) -> (payload, spec)` — Blosc(zstd, shuffle)-compress a numpy array.
- `decompress_array(payload, spec) -> arr` — invert `compress_array`.

## Containers

- `write_blosc(path, *, times_seconds, labels=None, quantization_us=100, extra_meta=None) -> int` — write a Blosc directory shard; returns bytes written.
- `read_blosc(path) -> dict` — read one, returns `{times, labels?, meta}`.
- `write_zarr(path, *, times_seconds, labels=None, quantization_us=100, group=None, chunk_size=None, extra_meta=None) -> None` — write a Zarr group.
- `read_zarr(path, *, group=None) -> dict` — read one, returns `{times, labels?, meta}`.

See [On-disk format](format.qmd) for the exact layout, and the
[tutorial](../tutorials/first-compression.qmd) for a worked example.
